Lessons.Title: Arithmetic Sequences
ExplanationParagraphs: Arithmetic sequences have constant common difference d.
Number of terms N=(last−first)/d+1 when d nonzero and N integer.
Models include constant monthly increases and fixed-rate progressions.
Independent Cool-down: calculate a representative source-family example and check the result with the definition.
